<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#0F3D56;
    --blue:#1565C0;
    --paper:#30343F;
    --amber:#FF6B00;
    --panel:#F5F7FA;

    --ink:#FFFFFF;
    --panel-2:#FFFFFF;
    --line:#E1E6ED;
    --paper-dim:#6B7280;
    --amber-dim:#FFE8D6;
    --blue-dim:#E3EDFB;
    --olive:#3E5872;
    --olive-dim:#E7ECF0;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    background:var(--ink);
    color:var(--paper);
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    line-height:1.6;
  }
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-weight:700;}
  .stamp,.tag,nav a,.btn{font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;}
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
  img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
  .wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;}

  /* ---------- header ---------- */
  header{
    position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;
    background:var(--navy);
    transition:box-shadow .25s ease;
  }
  header.scrolled{box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(15,61,86,0.25);}
  header .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:14px;padding-bottom:14px;gap:20px;}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-width:0;}
  .logo-chip{
    width:44px;height:44px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:10px;
    background:var(--panel);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  }
  .logo-chip img{width:30px;height:30px;object-fit:contain;display:block;}
  .brand-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.15;min-width:0;}
  .brand-text .name{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.02em;font-size:16px;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;}
  .brand-text .tagline{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:0.1em;color:#9FC2D6;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;}
  nav{display:flex;gap:26px;}
  nav a{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:0.04em;color:#C9DCE7;font-weight:500;text-transform:none;}
  nav a:hover{color:var(--amber);}
  .wa-btn{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
    background:var(--amber);color:#fff;
    padding:11px 20px;border-radius:6px;
    font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:0.03em;font-weight:600;
    border:none;cursor:pointer;text-transform:none;white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .wa-btn:hover{background:#FF8534;}
  @media(max-width:760px){nav{display:none;}}

  /* ---------- hero ---------- */
  .hero{
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0/34px 34px,
      linear-gradient(180deg,#0F3D56 0%,#0A2E42 100%);
    color:#fff;
  }
  .hero .wrap{
    padding-top:80px;padding-bottom:76px;
    max-width:760px;
  }
  .eyebrow{color:var(--blue);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:0.12em;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .hero .eyebrow{color:#5FA8FF;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .hero h1{font-size:42px;line-height:1.15;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-0.01em;margin-bottom:18px;}
  .hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--amber);}
  .hero p.lead{color:#C9DCE7;font-size:16.5px;max-width:52ch;margin-bottom:28px;font-weight:400;}
  .hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:36px;}
  .btn-outline{
    border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35);border-radius:6px;padding:12px 22px;font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;font-weight:600;color:#fff;text-transform:none;
  }
  .btn-outline:hover{border-color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);}
  .stat-row{display:flex;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .stat{border-left:2px solid var(--amber);padding-left:12px;}
  .stat b{display:block;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;}
  .stat span{font-size:12.5px;color:#A9C4D3;}

  /* ---------- sobre / quem somos ---------- */
  .sobre .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px 1fr;gap:44px;align-items:center;}
  .sobre-photo{
    background:var(--panel-2);border-radius:14px;padding:10px;
    box-shadow:0 14px 32px rgba(15,61,86,0.14);
  }
  .sobre-photo img{border-radius:8px;display:block;width:100%;}
  .sobre-copy p{color:var(--paper-dim);font-size:14.5px;margin-top:10px;max-width:52ch;}
  .contact-row{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:22px;}
  .contact-row a{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
    font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);
    border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:8px 16px;background:var(--panel);
  }
  .contact-row a svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .contact-row a:hover{border-color:var(--amber);color:var(--amber);}
  footer .copyright{font-size:12px;color:#9FC2D6;width:100%;text-align:center;margin-top:8px;}
  @media(max-width:760px){.sobre .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.sobre-photo{max-width:260px;margin:0 auto;}}


  section{padding:68px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .section-head{max-width:56ch;margin-bottom:38px;}
  .section-head .eyebrow{color:var(--blue);}
  .section-head h2{font-size:28px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.01em;}
  .section-head p{color:var(--paper-dim);margin-top:10px;font-size:14.5px;}

  /* ---------- services ---------- */
  .services{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}
  .svc{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px 1fr;gap:28px;
    background:var(--panel);border-left:4px solid var(--accent,var(--navy));
    border-radius:10px;
    padding:30px 32px;
  }
  .svc.electrica{--accent:var(--navy);}
  .svc.hidraulica{--accent:var(--blue);}
  .svc.pintura{--accent:var(--olive);}
  .svc-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;}
  .svc-icon{width:34px;height:34px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:6px;}
  .svc-head h3{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:0;}
  .svc-head span{font-size:11px;color:var(--paper-dim);letter-spacing:0.04em;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .svc ul{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;list-style:none;}
  .svc li{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--paper);position:relative;padding-left:16px;}
  .svc li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:7px;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);}
  @media(max-width:640px){.svc{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  .svc-expanded{grid-template-columns:220px 1fr;align-items:start;}
  .svc-groups{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;}
  .svc-group h4{
    font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.04em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .svc-group ul{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;list-style:none;}
  @media(max-width:900px){.svc-groups{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
  @media(max-width:640px){.svc-groups{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  /* ---------- area ---------- */
  .area{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px;}
  .chip{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:9px 20px;font-size:14.5px;letter-spacing:0.01em;color:var(--paper-dim);background:var(--panel);font-weight:500;}
  .chip-pending{border-style:dashed;color:var(--paper-dim);font-style:italic;}
  .area-group-label{display:block;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.03em;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:12px;}

  /* ---------- before/after ---------- */
  .ba-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;}
  .ba-card{background:var(--panel);border-radius:10px;padding:16px;}
  .ba-photos{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;}
  .ba-slot{
    aspect-ratio:4/3;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:8px;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    color:var(--paper-dim);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:0.05em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;
  }
  .ba-caption{margin-top:12px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--paper);text-align:center;}
  @media(max-width:760px){.ba-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  /* ---------- review ---------- */
  .review-block{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;}
  .review-copy p{color:var(--paper-dim);font-size:14.5px;max-width:44ch;margin-bottom:20px;}
  .review-qr{display:flex;justify-content:center;}
  .review-qr svg{width:220px;height:220px;background:#fff;padding:18px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);}
  @media(max-width:760px){.review-block{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  /* ---------- form / ticket ---------- */
  .form-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:44px;align-items:start;}
  .form-copy p{color:var(--paper-dim);font-size:14.5px;margin-top:10px;max-width:42ch;}
  .form-copy ul{list-style:none;margin-top:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
  .form-copy li{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--paper-dim);padding-left:18px;position:relative;}
  .form-copy li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:7px;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);}
  .ticket{
    background:var(--panel-2);
    border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;
    padding:28px;position:relative;
  }
  .ticket::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;left:-1px;right:-1px;bottom:56px;
    border-top:2px dashed var(--line);
  }
  .stamp{
    display:inline-block;background:var(--amber);color:#fff;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.06em;
    padding:5px 12px;border-radius:4px;margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .badge-photo{
    width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--panel);border:3px solid var(--amber);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .badge-photo svg{width:30px;height:30px;}
  .ticket h3{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:0.1em;color:var(--paper-dim);margin-bottom:4px;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .ticket-title{font-size:22px;color:var(--paper);margin-bottom:22px;font-weight:700;}
  .field{margin-bottom:16px;}
  label{display:block;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:0.03em;color:var(--paper-dim);margin-bottom:6px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;}
  input[type=text],input[type=tel],textarea,select{
    width:100%;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;
    color:var(--paper);padding:11px 12px;font-size:14px;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
  }
  textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:70px;}
  input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--amber);}
  .radio-row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .radio-row input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:0;height:0;}
  .radio-row label{
    border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:9px 14px;font-size:12.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.01em;cursor:pointer;margin:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--paper-dim);font-weight:500;
  }
  .radio-row input:checked + label{border-color:var(--amber);color:var(--amber);background:var(--amber-dim);}
  .submit-btn{
    width:100%;background:var(--amber);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;
    padding:14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.02em;cursor:pointer;margin-top:6px;
  }
  .submit-btn:hover{background:#FF8534;}
  .ticket-foot{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--paper-dim);margin-top:12px;text-align:center;}
  @media(max-width:760px){.form-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  /* ---------- footer ---------- */
  footer{padding:38px 0;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-top:none;}
  footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;}
  footer .brand-text .name{color:#fff;}
  footer .brand-text .tagline{color:#9FC2D6;}
  .social{display:flex;gap:20px;}
  .social a{font-size:13px;color:#C9DCE7;font-weight:500;}
  .social a:hover{color:var(--amber);}

  .wa-float{
    position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;z-index:60;
    width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--amber);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  }
  .wa-float svg{width:28px;height:28px;color:#fff;}
  .wa-float:hover{background:#FF8534;}

  a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{
    outline:2px solid var(--amber);outline-offset:2px;
  }
  .skip-link{
    position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;background:var(--amber);color:#fff;
    padding:10px 16px;border-radius:0 0 6px 0;z-index:100;
  }
  .skip-link:focus{left:0;}

  [data-reveal]{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px);transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .6s ease;}
  [data-reveal].is-visible{opacity:1;transform:none;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    [data-reveal]{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none;}
  }
</style>
</head>

    <h1>Quem cuida da sua casa <em>tem nome, endereço e WhatsApp.</em></h1>

  </div>

    <div class="section-head" data-reveal>

      <p>Do reparo pontual à reforma completa — em residências e em empresas.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="services">

      <div class="svc electrica svc-expanded" data-reveal>
        <div class="svc-head">
          <svg class="svc-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M13 2 4 14h7l-1 8 9-12h-7l1-8Z" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

          <span>Instalações e reparos com segurança</span>
        </div>

<section id="area">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head" data-reveal>

    </div>

<section id="orcamento">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="form-wrap">
      <div class="form-copy" data-reveal>
        <div class="eyebrow">Orçamento</div>
        <h2 style="font-size:26px;font-weight:600;">Conte o que precisa, a gente cuida do resto</h2>
        <p>Preencha a ordem de serviço abaixo. Ao enviar, sua solicitação abre direto no WhatsApp já preenchida — é só confirmar o envio.</p>
        <ul>
          <li>Resposta em até algumas horas</li>
          <li>Visita técnica antes de fechar valor</li>
          <li>Atendimento residencial e comercial</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <form class="ticket" id="orderForm">
        <div class="stamp">Orçamento</div>
        <h3>Ordem de serviço</h3>
        <div class="ticket-title">Pedido de visita</div>

        <div class="field">
          <label for="nome">Nome</label>
          <input type="text" id="nome" placeholder="Seu nome" required>
        </div>

        <div class="field">
          <label>Serviço (marque quantos precisar)</label>
          <div class="radio-row">
            <input type="checkbox" name="servico" id="s1" value="Elétrica"><label for="s1">Elétrica</label>
            <input type="checkbox" name="servico" id="s2" value="Hidráulica"><label for="s2">Hidráulica</label>
            <input type="checkbox" name="servico" id="s3" value="Pintura"><label for="s3">Pintura</label>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="field">
          <label for="endereco">Endereço / bairro</label>
          <input type="text" id="endereco" placeholder="Rua, bairro e cidade" required>
        </div>

        <div class="field">
          <label for="telefone">Telefone (opcional)</label>
          <input type="tel" id="telefone" placeholder="(81) 9 0000-0000">
        </div>

        <div class="field">
          <label for="detalhes">Detalhes (opcional)</label>
          <textarea id="detalhes" placeholder="Descreva o problema, se quiser"></textarea>
        </div>

        <button type="submit" class="submit-btn">Enviar para o WhatsApp</button>
        <div class="ticket-foot">Você será redirecionado ao WhatsApp para confirmar</div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="trabalhe-conosco">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="form-wrap">
      <div class="form-copy" data-reveal>
        <div class="eyebrow">Trabalhe conosco</div>
        <h2 style="font-size:26px;font-weight:600;">Quer fazer parte da equipe?</h2>
        <p>A gente cresce com quem tem capricho no acabamento e compromisso com o horário combinado. Se você manja de elétrica, hidráulica ou pintura, preenche a ficha ao lado.</p>
        <ul>
          <li>Vagas apenas para campo</li>
          <li>Prioridade pra quem já tem experiência prática</li>
          <li>Retorno em até alguns dias úteis</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <form class="ticket badge-card" id="jobForm">
        <div class="badge-photo" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="3.4"/><path d="M5 20c1.2-3.6 4-5.4 7-5.4s5.8 1.8 7 5.4" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
        </div>
        <div class="stamp">Candidatura</div>
        <h3>Ficha de candidatura</h3>
        <div class="ticket-title">Trabalhe Conosco</div>

        <div class="field">
          <label for="jnome">Nome completo</label>
          <input type="text" id="jnome" placeholder="Seu nome" required>
        </div>

        <div class="field">
          <label for="jtelefone">Telefone</label>
          <input type="tel" id="jtelefone" placeholder="(81) 9 0000-0000" required>
        </div>

        <div class="field">
          <label>Área de interesse (marque quantas quiser)</label>
          <div class="radio-row">
            <input type="checkbox" name="area-vaga" id="j1" value="Elétrica"><label for="j1">Elétrica</label>
            <input type="checkbox" name="area-vaga" id="j2" value="Hidráulica"><label for="j2">Hidráulica</label>
            <input type="checkbox" name="area-vaga" id="j3" value="Pintura"><label for="j3">Pintura</label>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="field">
          <label for="jexperiencia">Experiência</label>
          <select id="jexperiencia">
            <option value="Sem experiência / iniciante">Sem experiência / iniciante</option>
            <option value="Até 2 anos">Até 2 anos</option>
            <option value="De 2 a 5 anos">De 2 a 5 anos</option>
            <option value="Mais de 5 anos">Mais de 5 anos</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="field">
          <label for="jsobre">Fale um pouco sobre você</label>
          <textarea id="jsobre" placeholder="Experiência, cursos, disponibilidade..."></textarea>
        </div>

        <button type="submit" class="submit-btn">Enviar candidatura pelo WhatsApp</button>
        <div class="ticket-foot">Prefere mandar currículo em PDF? Envie pra <a href="mailto:heminioseletrica@gmail.com">heminioseletrica@gmail.com</a></div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="sobre" id="quem-somos">
  <div class="wrap">

<script>
(function(){
  var header = document.querySelector('header');
  function onScroll(){
    if(window.scrollY > 12){ header.classList.add('scrolled'); }
    else { header.classList.remove('scrolled'); }
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
  onScroll();
})();

(function(){
  var items = document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]');
  if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window) || !items.length){
    items.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add('is-visible'); });
    return;
  }
  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(entry){
      if(entry.isIntersecting){
        entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
        io.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.15 });
  items.forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
})();

document.getElementById('orderForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  var nome = document.getElementById('nome').value.trim();
  var endereco = document.getElementById('endereco').value.trim();
  var telefone = document.getElementById('telefone').value.trim();
  var detalhes = document.getElementById('detalhes').value.trim();
  var servicos = Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('input[name="servico"]:checked'), function(i){ return i.value; });
  var servico = servicos.length ? servicos.join(' + ') : 'Nao especificado';
  var msg = 'Ola Herminio! Peco um orcamento pelo site.\n';
  msg += 'Nome: ' + nome + '\n';
  msg += 'Servico: ' + servico + '\n';
  msg += 'Endereco: ' + endereco;
  if(telefone){ msg += '\nTelefone: ' + telefone; }
  if(detalhes){ msg += '\nDetalhes: ' + detalhes; }
  var url = 'https://wa.me/5581997260551?text=' + encodeURIComponent(msg);
  window.open(url, '_blank');
});

document.getElementById('jobForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  var nome = document.getElementById('jnome').value.trim();
  var telefone = document.getElementById('jtelefone').value.trim();
  var experiencia = document.getElementById('jexperiencia').value;
  var sobre = document.getElementById('jsobre').value.trim();
  var areas = Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('input[name="area-vaga"]:checked'), function(i){ return i.value; });

  var msg = 'Ola! Quero trabalhar com voces, vim pelo site.\n';
  msg += 'Nome: ' + nome + '\n';
  msg += 'Telefone: ' + telefone + '\n';
  msg += 'Area de interesse: ' + area + '\n';
  msg += 'Experiencia: ' + experiencia;
  if(sobre){ msg += '\nSobre mim: ' + sobre; }
  var url2 = 'https://wa.me/5581997260551?text=' + encodeURIComponent(msg);
  window.open(url2, '_blank');
});
</script>
